source_scope: targeted primary-source comparison; not an exhaustive novelty search

proposed_endpoint.quantifiers: There exist universal K < infinity and alpha > 0 such that for every finite d and every nonempty E subset of density matrices on M_d, e(E)^2 <= K (R(E)+1) b(E)^alpha.
proposed_endpoint.definitions: b(E) is the infimum over one full-domain two-output CPTP broadcaster of the worst over rho in E and both marginal half-trace errors; e(E) is the infimum over one full-domain EB channel of worst-state half-trace reconstruction error; R(E) is the infimum over centers in trace-closed conv(E) of the worst observational divergence sup over effects F of p ln(p/q).
proposed_endpoint.status_note: Exact interface is in work/agents/root_cycle05/INTERFACES.txt. This route does not establish the endpoint or a counterexample.

opportunities.historical_importance: A dimension-free power law would replace the current logarithmic-in-1/b extraction loss by finite-rate classical reconstruction controlled by the experiment's observational information radius.

strongest_prior.primary_source: Qi and Ranard, Emergent classicality in general multipartite states and channels, Quantum 5, 555 (2021), arXiv:2001.01507v3, Theorem 1 and Theorem 2.
strongest_prior.exact_mechanism: For any n-output CPTP channel, one POVM on the input approximates every reduced channel outside an excluded output set of size at most 2 d_A^6 ln(d_A) t / eps^2 by a measure-and-prepare channel in ordinary diamond norm eps, for all retained output subsets of size t. The state version uses S(A) and one-way LOCC_leftarrow norm.

concrete_scoped_consequence.statement: Given a broadcaster with E-marginal error b', recursively apply it m times to all leaves. Every one of n=2^m output marginals has E-error at most m b'. With t=1 and n>2 d^6 ln(d)/eps^2, Qi-Ranard supplies one good leaf and one full-domain EB map, so e(E) <= m b' + eps/2.
concrete_scoped_consequence.cost: The recursive tree uses n-1 calls to the supplied broadcaster; n is O(d^6 ln(d)/eps^2). The paper describes a constructive optimization procedure for locating the blanket and measurement, but the theorem statement gives no charged bit-complexity or acquisition-cost bound for extracting the POVM.
concrete_scoped_consequence.consequence: At fixed dimension, eps=b' gives e(E)=O_d(b log(d/b)), hence a dimension-dependent power bound for every exponent strictly below 2.

opportunities.candidate_new_mechanism: Strengthen the Markov-blanket entropy chain from a state-entropy budget S(A) to a family-specific information budget governed by R(E), then preserve the same POVM while converting the channel/state theorem to worst-state trace error. A proof-level step already follows by data processing: in Qi-Ranard Proposition 1's chain, the sum of measured conditional mutual-information increments is bounded by I(A:B_1...B_n) as well as S(A). For a fixed prior ensemble, the classical-label mutual information is bounded by its Holevo chi and hence by the max-prior Holevo capacity C(E).
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: A family-restricted finite common-measurement theorem must replace d_A or S(A) by the observational radius R(E), despite R(E) not being the Choi-reference entropy and with the center constrained to conv(E). It must then upgrade any prior-average or one-way-LOCC approximation to sup_{rho in E} output trace distance for the same full-domain EB map. The supplied interface states R(E) <= C(E)+ln(2), not a usable reverse bound C(E) <= R(E)+O(1).
compatibility_obligations: One broadcaster and one reconstruction channel must serve all rho in E.
Broadcast error is half trace on the two marginal outputs; tree error grows by at most m b through trace-distance contraction.
The target tests output trace distance in the worst input state; Qi-Ranard's state theorem is one-way LOCC_leftarrow and prior-averaged variants do not imply it.
The radius center must remain in trace-closed conv(E); arbitrary reference-state or Choi-center substitutions need proof.
The max-prior Holevo budget and observational radius are distinct; no reverse conversion was established in this source pass.
opportunities.early_falsification_test: First test the proposed intermediate inequality S(center) <= c(R(E)+1) on singleton families: R=0 while S(center)=ln(d), so this naive substitution is false. This does not falsify the endpoint because singleton families have e=0. Then test any proposed radius-budgeted blanket statement on finite families with large d but small measured radius, using exact state and channel matrices; do not treat failure of the S(center) substitution as a target counterexample.
opportunities.likely_significance_if_closed: Would provide a finite-rate, dimension-free quantitative no-broadcasting-to-common-EB theorem in terms of an operational radius, and remove the current exponential substate truncation from the power-law target.
opportunities.decision: Strong prior mechanism for fixed-d power bounds; requested dimension-free R(E) conversion remains unproved. No source reviewed here establishes the endpoint or supplies a matching obstruction.

rejected_analogies.reason: Pairwise approximate broadcasting/cloning assumes the second state is product-cloned and yields entropy contraction or recovery for that pair; the target broadcaster does not product-clone the radius center and needs one EB decoder for every state in E.

The objective is average Holevo-information transfer for a fixed ensemble, not closeness of output states to inputs; the authors state the general noncommuting-ensemble problem is not solved and give only special time-orbit bounds.
Targeted hits concern classical Potts broadcast reconstruction or unrelated PPT-square results, not quantum channel EB reconstruction; this scoped index result is not novelty evidence.
